# Gone Fission: Canned Fish Chowder

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jun 1, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_280ad65f5e2d469fbbd1e3c3820ff100~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Canned Fish Chowder__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_26ef5421ea4440fdb1a0a0350a93629d~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

- 25% Slowed Hunger for 30 minutes
- This buff works for Carnivore.
- Mutations and SIN do not affect duration or buff

**Buff Duration:**

- 30 minutes

**Radiation:**

- 2 Rads

**Ingredients**

- Fishing Bits x5
- Wood x3
- Boiled Water x1
- Salt x1
- Pepper x1
- Cream x1
- Clean Can x1 
 - Aluminum x2
 - Antiseptic x2
 - Copper x3
 - Steel x3

**Weight**

- 4 Pounds
- Can be reduced by Perk Cards and Legendary Mods

**Spoil Rate**

- Canned Food does not spoil

**Crafted at**

- Cooking Station > All Food
- Cooking Station > Meat
- Cooking Station > Prepared
- Cannery > Canned Food

**Perk Cards and Effects**

- Super Duper: Does not work when crafting on the Cannery.
- Stacking Effects: 
 - Stacks with other buffs that reduce or slow Hunger
- Persistence: This buff remains active even if you server-hop or leave the game.

**Obtained via**

- Plan: 
 - Auto Unlocked when you learn Recipe: Fish Chowder

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
